name: tempmhacks
description: Repository scaffold and local development commands for tempMhacks

scripts.db:generate: mkdir -p packages/db-generated/src/generated && spacetime generate --lang typescript --out-dir packages/db-generated/src/generated --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/db-generated && npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/shared && npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/messaging
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @tempmhacks/spacetimedb && npm run typecheck --workspace @tempmhacks/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @tempmhacks/photon && npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/evac
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && tsx --test spacetimedb/tests/*.test.ts services/alerts/tests/*.test.ts services/cv/tests/*.test.ts services/photon/tests/*.test.ts services/evac/tests/*.test.ts scripts/demo/*.test.ts && npm run test --workspace @tempmhacks/web
scripts.db:build: npm run typecheck && spacetime build --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.db:publish: npm run typecheck && spacetime publish --server local --module-path spacetimedb tempmhacks-local
scripts.db:publish:maincloud: npm run typecheck && spacetime publish --server maincloud --module-path spacetimedb $SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE
scripts.test:ios: cd apps/ios && xcodebuild -project SauronLocation.xcodeproj -scheme SauronLocation -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}" test
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @tempmhacks/web
scripts.dev:evac: npm run build:shared && npm run start --workspace @tempmhacks/evac
scripts.dev:cv: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @tempmhacks/cv
scripts.demo:start: node -e "console.log('Hosted DB: set SPACETIMEDB_* in .env, then run npm run demo:seed:cameras:sdk and npm run dev:photon / npm run dev:alerts / npm run dev:cv. Local DB: npm run demo:download-fixture, npm run db:publish, npm run demo:seed:cameras.')"
